description: This file defines an Android activity named Bouncer2 which contains an inner custom View class (MyView). The custom view displays a bitmap image that can be animated to bounce vertically using a ValueAnimator with an AccelerateInterpolator. The code handles shape positioning, drawing, and animation setup for a bouncing effect.

classes.name: Bouncer2
classes.description: An Android activity that hosts a custom view which animates a bitmap to bounce vertically.

classes.name: MyView
classes.description: A custom View that displays and animates a bitmap shape bouncing vertically with acceleration behavior.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets the activity's content view to the specified layout.

methods.name: setShapeX
methods.description: Updates the horizontal position of the shape and invalidates the affected region.

methods.name: setShapeY
methods.description: Updates the vertical position of the shape and invalidates the affected region.

methods.name: setupShape
methods.description: Loads the bitmap resource, initializes shape dimensions, and sets click listener to start animation.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Centers the shape horizontally when the view size changes, and resets vertical position.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the bitmap at its current position.

methods.name: startAnimation
methods.description: Creates, configures, and starts the ValueAnimator for bouncing animation.

methods.name: getValueAnimator
methods.description: Creates and returns a ValueAnimator that updates the shape's vertical position during animation.
